goal: Verify whether Article 14.3 of NeoGDPR Directive requires telemetry data to be permanently erased within 90 calendar days following customer contract termination.
successCriteria: Examine NeoGDPR regulatory text for data retention deadlines.

evidence.passage: Article 14.3: Service operators must permanently delete and scrub all collected telemetry logs within ninety (90) calendar days from the effective date of contract termination.

proposedAnswer: Article 14.3 of NeoGDPR Directive requires telemetry data to be permanently erased within 90 calendar days following customer contract termination.
